```{r}
obj <- readRDS(params$clinprog_object)
obj_class <- class(obj)[1]

is_regression <- obj_class == "clinprog_signature"
is_survival <- obj_class == "clinprog_survival"
is_complete <- obj_class == "clinprog_complete"

reg <- if (is_complete) obj$regression else if (is_regression) obj else NULL
surv <- if (is_complete) obj$survival else if (is_survival) obj else NULL

num_summary <- function(x){
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) == 0)
  {
    return(c(
      Minimum = NA_real_,
      Median = NA_real_,
      Mean = NA_real_,
      Maximum = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  c(
    Minimum = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Maximum = max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

emit_table <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = 4, font_size = 12, scale_down = FALSE)
{
  tbl <- knitr::kable(df, caption = caption, digits = digits, booktabs = TRUE,
                      format = ifelse(knitr::is_latex_output(), "latex", "html"))

  if (requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE))
  {
    if (knitr::is_latex_output())
    {
      latex_options <- "HOLD_position"
      if (scale_down) {latex_options <- c(latex_options, "scale_down")}

      tbl <- kableExtra::kable_styling(tbl,
                                       latex_options = latex_options,
                                       font_size = font_size)
    } else {
      tbl <- kableExtra::kable_styling(tbl,
                                       bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                                       full_width = TRUE, font_size = font_size)
    }
  }

  cat(tbl, sep = "\n")
}

params_to_df <- function(x)
{
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0)
  {
    return(data.frame(Parameter = character(0), Value = character(0)))
  }

  data.frame(
    Parameter = names(x),
    Value = vapply(x, function(v)
    {
      if (is.null(v)) {"NULL"} else {paste(v, collapse = ", ")}
    }, FUN.VALUE = character(1)),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

call_to_text <- function(x)
{
  paste(deparse(x), collapse = "\n")
}

status_label <- function(x)
{
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == 0 ~ "Alive / censored",
    x == 1 ~ "Dead / event",
    TRUE   ~ as.character(x))
}

infer_time_unit <- function(x)
{
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (all(is.na(x))) {return(NA_character_)}
  max_x <- max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (max_x > 100) {
    "days"
  } else if (max_x > 20) {
    "months"
  } else {
    "years"
  }
}

infer_followup_years <- function(x)
{
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (all(is.na(x))) {return(x)}
  unit <- infer_time_unit(x)
  if (unit == "days")   return(x / 365.25)
  if (unit == "months") return(x / 12)
  x
}
```

# Overview

This report provides an automated summary of the clinprog analysis, including model parameters, generated signatures, score-based survival stratification, Cox regression results, diagnostic plots, and key descriptive statistics. The goal is to provide a compact, reproducible, and interpretable record of the analysis workflow and its main outputs.

<div class="format-note">

```

# Module I - Regression

```{r}
#| results: asis

if (!is.null(reg)) {

  cat("## Function call\n\n")
  cat("```r\n")
  cat(call_to_text(reg$call), "\n")
  cat("```\n\n")

  cat("## Parameters\n\n")
  emit_table(
    params_to_df(reg$params),
    caption = "Regression module parameters",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\n## Signature\n\n")
  emit_table(
    reg$signature,
    caption = "Generated signature",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\n## Signature statistics\n\n")
  stats_df <- data.frame(
    Statistic = "Coefficient",
    t(num_summary(reg$signature$coefficient)),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  emit_table(
    stats_df,
    caption = "Coefficient summary statistics",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\nNumber of selected features:", nrow(reg$signature), "\n\n")
}
```

# Module II - Survival

```{r}
#| results: asis

if (!is.null(surv)) {

  cat("## Function call\n\n")
  cat("```r\n")
  cat(call_to_text(surv$call), "\n")
  cat("```\n\n")

  cat("## Parameters\n\n")
  emit_table(
    params_to_df(surv$params),
    caption = "Survival module parameters",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\n## Updated signature\n\n")
  emit_table(
    surv$signature,
    caption = "Updated signature",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\n## Signature statistics\n\n")
  surv_sig_stats <- data.frame(
    Statistic = "Coefficient",
    t(num_summary(surv$signature$coefficient)),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  emit_table(
    surv_sig_stats,
    caption = "Updated signature coefficient summary statistics",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\n## Score cutoff\n\n")
  score_cutoff_df <- data.frame(
    Metric = "Score cutoff",
    Criteria = surv$params$score_cutoff,
    Value = surv$score_cutoff_value
  )

  emit_table(
    score_cutoff_df,
    caption = "Score cutoff used for patient stratification",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\n## Score statistics\n\n")
  score_stats <- data.frame(
    Statistic = "Score",
    t(num_summary(surv$expression_data$score)),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  emit_table(
    score_stats,
    caption = "Score summary statistics",
    digits = 4
  )

  cat("\n\n## Clinical variables\n\n")

  if (is.null(surv$clinical_data))
  {
    cat("*No clinical variables available (multivariate analysis was not performed).*")
  } else {
    clinical_vars <- setdiff(colnames(surv$clinical_data),
                             c("OS", "OS.time", "score", "score_group"))

    if (length(clinical_vars) == 0)
    {
      cat("*No clinical covariates found in the clinical data.*\n\n")
    } else {
      clinical_df <- data.frame(Variable = clinical_vars, Categories = vapply(
        surv$clinical_data[, clinical_vars, drop = FALSE], function(x)
          {length(unique(stats::na.omit(x)))},
        FUN.VALUE = integer(1)),
        Values = vapply(surv$clinical_data[, clinical_vars, drop = FALSE], function(x)
          {paste(unique(stats::na.omit(x)), collapse = ", ")},
          FUN.VALUE = character(1)), row.names = NULL)

      emit_table(clinical_df,
                 caption = "Clinical variables available for survival analysis",
                 digits = 4)
    }
  }

  cat("\n\n## Univariate Cox table\n\n")
  uni_table <- surv$survival$univariate$table
  rownames(uni_table) <- NULL
  emit_table(uni_table, caption = "Univariate Cox model",
             digits = 4, font_size = 7, scale_down = TRUE)

  if (!is.null(surv$survival$multivariate))
  {
    cat("\n\n## Multivariate Cox table\n\n")
    emit_table(
      surv$survival$multivariate$table,
      caption = "Multivariate Cox model",
      digits = 4,
      font_size = 7,
      scale_down = TRUE
    )
  }

  cat("\n\n## Proportional hazards table\n\n")
  ph_table <- surv$ph_result$table
  rownames(ph_table) <- gsub("^score_group$", "Score", rownames(ph_table))
  emit_table(
    ph_table,
    caption = "Proportional hazards test",
    digits = 4
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-cap: "Global distribution of expression values used for score calculation."

if (!is.null(surv)) {

  expr_cols <- setdiff(
    colnames(surv$expression_data),
    c("OS", "OS.time", "score", "score_group")
  )

  expr_values <- unlist(surv$expression_data[, expr_cols, drop = FALSE])

  # Checks if expression data needs to be log2-transformed
  if (surv$params$norm_exp)
  {
    expr_df <- data.frame(Expression = as.numeric(expr_values))
  } else {
    expr_df <- data.frame(Expression = log2(as.numeric(expr_values) + 1))
  }

  ggplot2::ggplot(expr_df, ggplot2::aes(x = "", y = Expression)) +
    ggplot2::geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.3, color = "gray50") +
    ggplot2::geom_violin(fill = "#ECE7F2", color = "#A6BDDB", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7,
                          fill = "#1C9099", alpha = 0.8, color = "#016C59") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = "log2(Expression + 1)")
}
```

## Survival Data Summary

```{r}
#| results: asis

if (!is.null(surv)) {
  # informative note about the inferred time unit
  max_time <- max(surv$expression_data$OS.time, na.rm = TRUE)
  assumed_unit <- infer_time_unit(surv$expression_data$OS.time)
  cat(sprintf("*Follow-up time assumed to be in **%s** (max observed value = %s).*\n\n",
              assumed_unit, round(max_time, 2)))

  os_df <- as.data.frame(table(status_label(surv$expression_data$OS)))
  colnames(os_df) <- c("Status", "Count")

  emit_table(
    os_df,
    caption = "Overall survival status",
    digits = 4
  )

  followup_years <- infer_followup_years(surv$expression_data$OS.time)

  followup_df <- data.frame(
    Followup = c("<= 1 year", "<= 3 years", "<= 5 years", "<= 10 years"),
    Count = c(
      sum(followup_years <= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(followup_years <= 3, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(followup_years <= 5, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(followup_years <= 10, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

  emit_table(
    followup_df,
    caption = "Follow-up time summary",
    digits = 4
  )

  followup_stats <- data.frame(
    Statistic = "OS.time (years)",
    t(num_summary(followup_years)),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  emit_table(
    followup_stats,
    caption = "Follow-up summary statistics",
    digits = 4
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of followup time."

if (!is.null(surv)) {

  followup_years <- infer_followup_years(surv$expression_data$OS.time)
  followup_plot_df <- data.frame(Followup = followup_years)
  n_obs <- length(na.omit(followup_years))
  binwidth <- diff(range(followup_years, na.rm = TRUE)) / 30

  ggplot2::ggplot(followup_plot_df, ggplot2::aes(x = .data$Followup)) +
    ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#1C9099", color = "white",
                            linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
    ggplot2::geom_density(ggplot2::aes(y = ggplot2::after_stat(.data$density) * n_obs * binwidth), color = "#016C59", linewidth = 1) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = NULL, x = "Followup time (years)", y = "Patients") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   panel.grid.minor.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   panel.border = ggplot2::element_blank())
}

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: "ROC curve."

if (!is.null(surv) && !is.null(surv$roc_result) &&
    !is.null(surv$roc_result$optimal_cutpoint$data) &&
    requireNamespace("pROC", quietly = TRUE)) {
  roc_data <- surv$roc_result$optimal_cutpoint$data

  roc_obj <- pROC::roc(response = roc_data$OS, predictor = roc_data$score,
    direction = surv$roc_result$direction, quiet = TRUE)

  roc_df <- data.frame(Specificity = rev(roc_obj$specificities),
                       Sensitivity = rev(roc_obj$sensitivities))

  roc_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(roc_df, ggplot2::aes(x = 1 - Specificity, y = Sensitivity)) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "blue") +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "gray") +
    ggplot2::coord_equal() + ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black"),
                   axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black")) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = NULL,
                  subtitle = paste0("AUC = ", round(surv$roc_result$auc, 3)),
                  x = "1 - Specificity", y = "Sensitivity")

  print(roc_plot)
}
```

### Bootstrap covariate frequency

```{r}
#| results: asis

if (!is.null(surv) && !is.null(surv$survival$boot_table)) {
  boot_tbl <- surv$survival$boot_table
  n_boot <- surv$params$bootstrap

  # Cosmetic rename: score_group -> Score
  boot_tbl$covariate <- gsub("^score_group$", "Score", boot_tbl$covariate)

  # If bootstrap = 1, frequencies are trivial (each selected covariate appears exactly once)
  # So, show only counts and add an explicit note for the reader.
  if (is.null(n_boot) || !is.numeric(n_boot) || n_boot < 2) {
    colnames(boot_tbl) <- c("Covariate", "Frequency (n)")
    cat(sprintf("*Note: bootstrap was performed with %s iteration(s); ",
                if (is.null(n_boot)) "an unknown number of" else n_boot))
    cat("frequencies are not informative and percentages are omitted.*\n\n")
  } else {
    boot_tbl$frequency_pct <- round(100 * boot_tbl$frequency / n_boot, 1)
    boot_tbl <- boot_tbl[, c("covariate", "frequency", "frequency_pct")]
    colnames(boot_tbl) <- c("Covariate", "Frequency (n)", "Frequency (%)")
  }

  emit_table(boot_tbl,
             caption = "Covariate selection frequency across bootstrap iterations",
             digits = 4)

} else {
  cat("*No bootstrap frequency table available (multivariate bootstrap was not performed).*\n\n")
}
```
